quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The cleft sentence rejects an obvious focus (mistakes) for a subtler one (confidence).
quests.explanation: Cleft sentence: What is striking (the focus) + is not that AI makes mistakes (expected answer, rejected) + but how confidently it makes them (the real, subtler point). Redirects attention from fact to manner.
quests.textToSpeak: What is striking is not that AI makes mistakes, but how confidently it makes them.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'For every X, countless Y' contrasts one visible success with many invisible ones.
quests.explanation: Ratio (For every policy that succeeds) + contrast (countless smaller efforts go completely unnoticed). This pattern highlights how rare visible success is compared to unseen effort.
quests.textToSpeak: For every policy that succeeds, countless smaller efforts go completely unnoticed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A tempting but incomplete idea is corrected by 'but the reality is more complicated'.
quests.explanation: Tempting belief (It is tempting to think that more hospitals alone would fix the shortage) + correction (but the reality is more complicated). Politely dismantles an oversimplified assumption.
quests.textToSpeak: It is tempting to think that more hospitals alone would fix the shortage, but the reality is more complicated.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Good intentions are conceded before a more practical problem is named.
quests.explanation: Concession (However well-intentioned the reform may be) + main clause (implementation often falls short of the vision). Separates the quality of an idea from the quality of its execution.
quests.textToSpeak: However well-intentioned the reform may be, implementation often falls short of the vision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'So accustomed have X become to Y that Z' is an inverted present perfect structure.
quests.explanation: Degree (So accustomed have people become to instant replies) + result (that silence now feels like rejection). Shows how a habit can quietly reshape emotional expectations.
quests.textToSpeak: So accustomed have people become to instant replies that silence now feels like rejection.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'There is a reason X' implies the reason is worth investigating, even if unstated.
quests.explanation: There is a reason (framing phrase) + certain algorithms remain popular long after better ones emerge (the pattern needing explanation). Invites the listener to consider an underlying cause.
quests.textToSpeak: There is a reason certain algorithms remain popular long after better ones emerge.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The infinitive opener states a goal; the main clause explains how to reach it.
quests.explanation: Goal (To understand why coastlines are eroding faster) + method (one must first consider decades of development). 'One must first' formally states a necessary first step.
quests.textToSpeak: To understand why coastlines are eroding faster, one must first consider decades of development.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'That said' pivots from an implied criticism toward a fair acknowledgment.
quests.explanation: That said (transitional phrase) + the new screening program remains one of the region's genuine successes (fair acknowledgment). Signals a balanced turn after discussing a problem.
quests.textToSpeak: That said, the new screening program remains one of the region's genuine successes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'It is no exaggeration to say that X' insists a strong claim is actually accurate.
quests.explanation: It is no exaggeration to say that (emphasis phrase) + a single teacher can alter a child's entire trajectory (the strong claim). Defends a claim that might otherwise sound like hyperbole.
quests.textToSpeak: It is no exaggeration to say that a single teacher can alter a child's entire trajectory.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'As history has repeatedly shown' frames the claim as an established pattern, not a guess.
quests.explanation: As history has repeatedly shown (evidence framing) + censorship rarely eliminates the ideas it targets (the claim). Lends weight to a claim by pointing to a long, repeated pattern.
quests.textToSpeak: As history has repeatedly shown, censorship rarely eliminates the ideas it targets.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The same cleft pattern as before, applied to a technology failure.
quests.explanation: Cleft sentence: What is striking (the focus) + is not that the model failed (rejected focus) + but how long the failure went unnoticed (the real point). Shifts attention to the delay in noticing.
quests.textToSpeak: What is striking is not that the model failed, but how long the failure went unnoticed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The same 'for every X, Y' ratio pattern, applied to emissions.
quests.explanation: Ratio (For every ton of carbon captured) + contrast (industry still emits many more elsewhere). Puts a single positive action into a much larger, sobering context.
quests.textToSpeak: For every ton of carbon captured, industry still emits many more elsewhere.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Another tempting idea, corrected by a fact about how hard habits are to break.
quests.explanation: Tempting belief (It is tempting to think that awareness alone changes behavior) + correction (but habits prove far more stubborn). 'Stubborn' vividly describes resistance to change.
quests.textToSpeak: It is tempting to think that awareness alone changes behavior, but habits prove far more stubborn.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Good design is conceded, then shown to be insufficient on its own.
quests.explanation: Concession (However well-intentioned the curriculum may be) + main clause (it cannot replace an engaged, attentive teacher). Argues human factors outweigh even excellent design.
quests.textToSpeak: However well-intentioned the curriculum may be, it cannot replace an engaged, attentive teacher.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The same inverted 'so accustomed' structure, now applied to entertainment habits.
quests.explanation: Degree (So accustomed have audiences become to constant sequels) + result (that originality now feels risky). Shows how repeated exposure can quietly change what feels safe or normal.
quests.textToSpeak: So accustomed have audiences become to constant sequels that originality now feels risky.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The reason is implied but not stated — the listener is invited to consider it.
quests.explanation: There is a reason (framing phrase) + engineers still test systems that appear to work perfectly (the practice needing explanation). Implies caution is justified even when things seem fine.
quests.textToSpeak: There is a reason engineers still test systems that appear to work perfectly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The infinitive goal is followed by the necessary first step to reach it.
quests.explanation: Goal (To understand why the glacier retreated so quickly) + method (one must first examine decades of temperature data). Common in explaining complex scientific findings clearly.
quests.textToSpeak: To understand why the glacier retreated so quickly, one must first examine decades of temperature data.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A fair, positive point follows what might have been an implied criticism.
quests.explanation: That said (transitional phrase) + the clinic's outreach program has reached communities others overlooked entirely (the positive point). 'Overlooked entirely' emphasizes prior neglect.
quests.textToSpeak: That said, the clinic's outreach program has reached communities others overlooked entirely.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A strong claim about early reading is defended as entirely accurate.
quests.explanation: It is no exaggeration to say that (emphasis phrase) + early literacy shapes almost everything that follows (the strong claim). 'Everything that follows' is itself a relative clause, adding scope.
quests.textToSpeak: It is no exaggeration to say that early literacy shapes almost everything that follows.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Precisely when' pinpoints an exact, almost counterintuitive condition.
quests.explanation: As history has repeatedly shown (evidence framing) + art movements thrive precisely when institutions resist them (the claim). 'Precisely when' insists timing itself matters.
quests.textToSpeak: As history has repeatedly shown, art movements thrive precisely when institutions resist them.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The cleft pattern once more, paired with a modal perfect: 'could have been prevented'.
quests.explanation: Cleft sentence: What is striking (the focus) + is not that the breach occurred (rejected focus) + but how easily it could have been prevented (the real point). Expresses a missed past opportunity.
quests.textToSpeak: What is striking is not that the breach occurred, but how easily it could have been prevented.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The same ratio pattern, now emphasizing unequal access to resources.
quests.explanation: Ratio (For every community that adapts successfully) + contrast (several others still lack the resources to try). Draws attention to inequality hidden behind a single success story.
quests.textToSpeak: For every community that adapts successfully, several others still lack the resources to try.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A tempting shortcut is corrected by a reminder about prevention's ongoing importance.
quests.explanation: Tempting belief (It is tempting to think that new drugs replace old habits) + correction (but prevention still matters most). Resists the assumption that treatment can replace healthy habits.
quests.textToSpeak: It is tempting to think that new drugs replace old habits, but prevention still matters most.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: This shortened concession again drops the verb after the adjective.
quests.explanation: Concession (However well-intentioned the policy) + main clause (it overlooked the realities rural schools actually face). 'Rural schools actually face' modifies 'realities' with no relative pronoun.
quests.textToSpeak: However well-intentioned the policy, it overlooked the realities rural schools actually face.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past perfect ('had become') shows this habit was already fully formed before the change happened.
quests.explanation: Degree (So accustomed had the city become to its skyline) + result (that the sudden change unsettled everyone). Past perfect places the whole pattern firmly in the past.
quests.textToSpeak: So accustomed had the city become to its skyline that the sudden change unsettled everyone.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Again, an unstated reason is implied, inviting the listener to think it through.
quests.explanation: There is a reason (framing phrase) + so many companies still hesitate to fully automate hiring (the hesitation needing explanation). Suggests caution is reasonable, even if unexplained here.
quests.textToSpeak: There is a reason so many companies still hesitate to fully automate hiring.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The necessary first step this time involves identifying affected parties.
quests.explanation: Goal (To understand why the policy stalled) + method (one must first consider who stood to lose the most). 'Stood to lose' means 'would have lost if it had proceeded'.
quests.textToSpeak: To understand why the policy stalled, one must first consider who stood to lose the most.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A generous acknowledgment follows what could have been a more critical framing.
quests.explanation: That said (transitional phrase) + the vaccine campaign achieved far more than early skeptics predicted (the acknowledgment). A fair, balanced way to end on a positive note.
quests.textToSpeak: That said, the vaccine campaign achieved far more than early skeptics predicted.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A bold claim about mentorship is defended as simple fact, not exaggeration.
quests.explanation: It is no exaggeration to say that (emphasis phrase) + a good mentor can outweigh years of formal training (the strong claim). 'Outweigh' means to matter more than something else being compared.
quests.textToSpeak: It is no exaggeration to say that a good mentor can outweigh years of formal training.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The final sentence layers a nested relative clause inside the main claim.
quests.explanation: As history has repeatedly shown (evidence framing) + every generation believes its technology will be the one that changes everything ('that changes everything' as a nested relative clause). Closes with gentle irony about repeated overconfidence.
quests.textToSpeak: As history has repeatedly shown, every generation believes its technology will be the one that changes everything.
